notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.0b
notes.content:
Hello everyone,



I've just fixed a bug where characters in combat could be stuck in endless running animations.



That's all, cheers,

 Tim

notes.title: Big Update 1.2.0 is now live... including a Linux version
notes.content:
Hi folks,

I've released another update for the game and this is pretty big. Here's what changed:

Added support for Linux

Rewrote the whole path finding to make it more performant and easier to understand. No more lag-spikes when attacking or moving around

Update to Unity version 6

Fixed an issue where you couldn't swap weapons during the final encounter

Fixed an issue where you could swap weapons around freely even though you already used them. (this was not intentional)

Fixed an issue where you could move at double speed in the hospital mini-game

Fixed several typos and other text issues

Mirrored fist icon in inventory to fit with combat screen

A ton of additional other small fixes you'll probably won't even notice



Cheers,

 Tim

notes.title: Small Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

just released a small fix for getting stuck when you win or lose a battle and another small one where items could be lost after battle when you switched them during battle.

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

just released a new update with several bug-fixes:
-The cursor should not vanish in combat
-General issues with combat and combat completion
-Fixed a bug where you could press buttons multiple times during screen transition
-Fixed an issue with ant and player spawning on smaller maps

And I also added another cheat:
-Type "IDDQD" during combat to become invincible, have unlimited ammo and 100% hit chance.

Enjoy! :)

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the final battle sometimes didn't work properly.

Sorry for the inconvenience,
 have fun playing! :)

notes.title: Update 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm happy to announce a new update... and it's a rather big one. :)

New features:
-Completely reworked how you select weapons during combat to be much less confusing
-Recreated all random combat areas. They are now much smaller and more action-packed. No more endless searching for ants!
-30+ bug-fixes small to medium

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43112224/b90c297ee68365042eb46ae33fbc776fbbb5fd2f.png

Have fun! :)

notes.title: New Update with New Features
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I've just released a new update for the game with some nice QoL features:

If you send one of your party members to recruit others and there's already a person available to recruit you will now get notified and get a marker on the map where you have to go.
When you press 'escape' during combat you can now flee the fight. This is only possible of no ants are in visible range and you won't get any town alertness.
When you stash a weapon during combat that you don't have any ammunition for you will now always get the fist as an active weapon. Thus the empty weapon doesn't block the weapon slot anymore.
Several smaller bug-fixes


Enjoy! :)

notes.title: Update: Game now Playable on the Steam Deck
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm happy to tell you that the game is now "playable" on the Steam Deck. You should encounter no problems while playing through the game. (Note: the game is not completely optimized for controller play and the best experience is still to play with mouse and keyboard.)

Other changes:
-Added notification animation on closed upper menu to make new notifications more visible
-Small improvements in combat controls and edge-casses
-Minor bug-fixes

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I've got a new update for you! :)

Patch Notes:

 Added a mouse-over icon for weapon stashing to make it more clear what happens when you click on a weapon in combat.
 Added functionality to select a friendly character in combat by clicking on it.
 Added more map markers
 Some smaller bug fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
Got a small new update for you all! :)

Changelog

 Improved Drag&Drop in inventory, making it easier to drop items at the selected position.
 Added notification in top menu when new party members are unlocked.
 Added exclamation mark on-top the Air Field when recon flights are available.
 Several minor bug fixes and improvements.


Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Patch Notes
By popular demand I've added the following features:

 You can now zoom out on the map with the mouse scroll wheel or by pressing space.
 The settings are now also available from the pause menu.
 Stashing a weapon no longer consumes an action point. Rather you can't stash a weapon when you have no action points left. This should be more intuitive behavior.


And a few minor fixes and corrected typos.

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
I've got another update for you. :)

Features

 New settings for fullscreen mode and pixel scaling options
 Dialog options don't get hidden if you haven't got enough money for them but are still shown greyed-out
 WASD and Space Bar controls for the hospital scene


Fixes

 Fixed a crash after the ant chase scene
 Fixed a bug where the second page of the notebook was shown too early
 Minor fixes and typo corrections


Have fun! :D

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 released
notes.content:
Change Log:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where you couldn't click on locations if you saved on the town map
 Fixed a bug where you didn't get dialog if you save during the tutorial
 Fixed a bug where you would never hit an enemy with a Rock
 Fixed a bug where you seemingly got 2 items when you looted them
 Fixed spelling errors
 Fixed a bug where the crashed car was displayed too big in the combat scenario
 Fixed a bug where you could interrupt a character movement by switching to another character in combat


Changes

 Added a smoke animation for the meteor on the map to make it more visible
 Removed the Spring Festival locations before you talked to the professor to make the University easier to find
 Added a notification icon when the notebook has new entries.
 Added a hint that you should use the recon plane to investigate the ant hills
 Improved tooltip for the syringe and healing drugs to make them easier to understand


Cheers,
 Tim
